name: Protopasta High Density Iron HTPLA
filament_notes:
60% iron by weight. Proto-Pasta publishes no TDS for this line; settings follow their metal-composite row (200C@24 mm3/s, 55C plate) and density is estimated at ~2x base polymer from their published description - verify by weighing a known length.
Avoid printing below 3 mm3/s. Hardened nozzle recommended. Brittle in spool form. Anneal like HTPLA for heat resistance.
